description: Backend: replace the immediate trainer auto-link with a PENDING request + Approve/Reject flow, reusing the single trainerLinks/{studentUid} doc with an expanded status enum (add 'pending' and 'rejected'; keep 'active' == APPROVED to avoid churning existing ownership/count/list queries). Add trainer-only Requests endpoints, a pending-aware ownership check, and switch the two existing immediate-link entry points to request semantics. All in the backend worktree. Independent of FEAT-003; FEAT-002 depends on the endpoints this feature adds.
steps: Add a central status enum to backend .worktree src/models/domain.ts: export const TRAINER_LINK_STATUSES = ['pending','active','rejected','inactive'] as const; and type TrainerLinkStatus. Document inline that 'active' IS the approved state (reused intentionally), 'pending' = awaiting approval, 'rejected' = declined, and that the single trainerLinks/{studentUid} doc is reused rather than a new collection (single-trainer invariant already enforced).

Extend src/repositories/trainerLinkRepository.ts: add listRequestsByTrainer(trainerId) = where('trainerId','==',t).where('status','==','pending') then in-memory sort by updatedAt desc (mirror the existing listByTrainer shape). Reuses the existing (trainerId ASC, status ASC, updatedAt DESC) composite index — NO new index. Keep get/listByTrainer/doc/fieldValue unchanged.

Add methods to src/services/trainerService.ts (keep linkStudent + createStudentLink as the transaction template; do not delete them). requestTrainer(studentUid, code): validate exactly like linkStudent (resolve referralCodes/{codeLower} -> active trainer; unknown/not-a-trainer -> soft {ok:false, reason:'invalid_code'}; caller role 'trainer' -> ConflictError/409). If an existing link to the SAME trainer is already pending or active -> idempotent soft success {ok:true, status:<existing>} with no write. If an active link to a DIFFERENT trainer exists -> {ok:false, reason:'already_linked', currentTrainer, requestedTrainer} (no silent overwrite; a switch is a new pending request, never an auto-switch). Otherwise write trainerLinks/{studentUid} status:'pending', trainerId, createdAt(if new)/updatedAt — and do NOT mirror profile.trainerId and do NOT increment totalStudents.

Add approveRequest(trainerId, studentUid): require the pending-aware ownership check (next step) then, in one transaction (reuse the createStudentLink pattern), set status:'active', mirror users/{studentUid}/profile/data.trainerId AND new field trainerStatus:'approved', and +1 totalStudents (guarded so it increments exactly once). Add rejectRequest(trainerId, studentUid): require pending + ownership, set status:'rejected' (no profile mirror, no counter change). Add listRequestsForTrainer(trainerId): call trainerLinkRepository.listRequestsByTrainer then enrich each with the student's name + photoUrl via profileRepository.get (name+photo only, like listStudents but slimmer).

In src/middleware/role.ts: keep assertTrainerOwnsStudent requiring status==='active' VERBATIM (a pending link must grant NO data access). Add assertTrainerOwnsPendingRequest(trainerId, studentUid) that reads trainerLinks/{studentUid} and throws NotFoundError (404, not 403 — anti-enumeration) unless the link exists, trainerId===caller, and status==='pending'. Used only by approve/reject.

In src/validators/trainerValidators.ts: reuse/re-export studentUidParamsSchema for the :studentUid approve/reject route params (no body needed). Keep linkTrainerSchema unchanged (still the body for the now-request-creating connect/link endpoints).

In src/routes/trainer.routes.ts (after the existing router.use(authenticate); router.use(requireTrainer);): add GET /requests -> listRequests; POST /requests/:studentUid/approve (validate params) -> approveRequest; POST /requests/:studentUid/reject (validate params) -> rejectRequest. In src/controllers/trainerController.ts add the three handlers using requireUid(req) for trainerId and returning ok(res, {requests}) / ok(res, {ok:true, studentUid, status}). approve/reject go through the service methods (which call assertTrainerOwnsPendingRequest first).

Switch the two immediate-link entry points to request semantics: src/controllers/studentController.ts connectTrainer (POST /api/student/connect-trainer) and src/controllers/authController.ts linkTrainer (POST /api/auth/link-trainer) now call trainerService.requestTrainer(uid, referralCode) instead of linkStudent. Preserve soft-fail-on-invalid-code (unknown code -> {ok:false, reason:'invalid_code'} HTTP 200, never error out registration). A valid code now creates a PENDING request, not an active link.

Confirm NO firebase/ change is required (existing composite index covers the pending query; trainerLinks already backend-only in rules; trainerStatus mirror lives under users/{uid}/profile/data which is already owner-readable). If any firebase/ file is edited, do NOT commit it and flag it for the user.

Update backend tests in LOCKSTEP (do not weaken behavior to pass stale auto-link assertions). src/__tests__/trainerService.test.ts: change assertions that expected status:'active' immediately after connect/link to expect status:'pending' with NO profile.trainerId mirror and NO totalStudents increment; add cases for requestTrainer (invalid_code soft-fail, trainer-as-student 409, duplicate-pending idempotent, already_linked-to-different-trainer), approveRequest (pending->active + mirror trainerId + trainerStatus:'approved' + count +1; non-pending/non-owner -> 404), rejectRequest (pending->rejected, no mirror/no count), listRequestsForTrainer (only pending, enriched name+photo). src/__tests__/trainerRoutes.test.ts: add GET /api/trainer/requests and POST /requests/:studentUid/approve|reject incl. 404 on wrong-trainer/non-pending; confirm assertTrainerOwnsStudent still 404s on the per-student data routes for a pending (not-yet-approved) link. Keep roleService.test.ts, userRepository.test.ts, referralCode.test.ts, middleware.test.ts and all unrelated suites GREEN.
acceptance_criteria: trainerLinks/{studentUid} supports status in {pending, active, rejected, inactive}; 'active' remains the approved state used by listByTrainer/countActiveStudents/assertTrainerOwnsStudent.

POST /api/student/connect-trainer and POST /api/auth/link-trainer create a PENDING request (status:'pending') on a valid code — NOT an active link, NO profile.trainerId mirror, NO totalStudents increment; an unknown code is still a soft {ok:false, reason:'invalid_code'} at HTTP 200.
GET /api/trainer/requests (trainer-only) returns only pending requests enriched with student name + photoUrl.

POST /api/trainer/requests/:studentUid/approve sets status:'active', mirrors profile.trainerId + trainerStatus:'approved', and increments totalStudents exactly once; reject sets status:'rejected' with no mirror/no count; both 404 for a non-owning trainer or a non-pending link.
assertTrainerOwnsStudent still requires status==='active' (a pending link grants no per-student data access).
Running the backend suite passes with the updated approval-behavior assertions and the new request/approve/reject tests.
verification: npm test  (all suites pass, incl. updated trainerService.test.ts and trainerRoutes.test.ts)
findings:
DONE. Backend lint+typecheck+test all green (21 files / 175 tests; baseline was 149, +26 new). No firebase/ change needed or made.

ENDPOINTS FEAT-002 (frontend) should call (all under /api, trainer routes require a trainer token):
- POST /api/student/connect-trainer  body {referralCode:string}  -> now REQUEST semantics.
- POST /api/auth/link-trainer  body {referralCode:string}  -> same requestTrainer path (register-time connect). NOTE: confirmSwitch is no longer honored by these two endpoints (they create a pending request; a switch is just a new request). The body validator (linkTrainerSchema) still ACCEPTS an optional confirmSwitch field, so sending it is harmless/ignored.
- GET  /api/trainer/requests  -> { requests: Array<{studentUid, name|null, photoUrl|null, requestedAt|null}> } (pending only, newest first).
- POST /api/trainer/requests/:studentUid/approve  -> { ok:true, studentUid, status:'active' }.
- POST /api/trainer/requests/:studentUid/reject   -> { ok:true, studentUid, status:'rejected' }.
  approve/reject 404 (NOT 403, anti-enumeration) when the caller is not the owning trainer or the link is not status==='pending'.

RESPONSE ENVELOPE: all responses are wrapped by ok(res, payload) => HTTP body { data: <payload> } (success). The connect/link endpoints return their payload directly as data, e.g. data = { ok:true, status:'pending', trainerId, trainerName } on a valid new request; data = { ok:false, reason:'invalid_code' } (HTTP 200) on a bad/typo code; data = { ok:false, reason:'already_linked', currentTrainer:{trainerId,name|null}, requestedTrainer:{trainerId,name|null} } when an ACTIVE link to a different trainer already exists; data = { ok:true, status:'active'|'pending', trainerId, trainerName } (idempotent) when a same-trainer link already exists.

STATUS MODEL on trainerLinks/{studentUid}: enum TRAINER_LINK_STATUSES = ['pending','active','rejected','inactive'] (src/models/domain.ts). 'active' IS the approved state (unchanged for listByTrainer/countActiveStudents/assertTrainerOwnsStudent). A 'pending' link grants NO per-student data access (assertTrainerOwnsStudent still requires status==='active').

PROFILE MIRROR for the student: on APPROVE, users/{studentUid}/profile/data gets trainerId:<trainerId> AND a NEW field trainerStatus:'approved' (string). This is the field FEAT-002 should read to show the student's connected-trainer card / read-only Trainer Code. On a pending request there is NO profile mirror yet; on reject there is none either. Backend code field names referralCode/referralCodeLower/referralCodeUpdatedAt kept STABLE.
